title: Very large programme order that exceeds free sewing capacity before ex-factory
subject: PO MVS-300457 – basic tee programme
body:
Hello Karthik,

We'd like to place our first basics programme with you. PO MVS-300457 is attached: MV-TS-01 basic crew tee in three colours, 54,000 pcs in total, USD 2.40, FOB Chennai, ex-factory April 2, 2027, shipping to our DC in Dallas, TX.

Please confirm you can take the full volume on this date.

Best,
Carla Mendes
Meridian Value Stores Inc.
